records.english: Lateen sails excel upwind. Never mount a square sail behind one.
records.speaker: Refit equipment help
records.context: The player compares the adjacent sails in Refit equipment.
records.source_meaning: Lateen sails perform well upwind. A square sail cannot be fitted behind a lateen sail.
records.localization_note: Keep the upwind advantage and the restriction on a square sail behind. Rephrase to keep the start of the instruction together.

records.english: With a following wind, square sails work well. Never mount a lateen sail ahead of one.
records.speaker: Refit equipment help
records.context: The player compares the adjacent sails in Refit equipment.
records.source_meaning: Square sails perform well in a following wind. A lateen sail cannot be fitted ahead of a square sail.
records.localization_note: Keep the following-wind advantage and the restriction on a lateen sail ahead. Rephrase to keep the start of the instruction together.
